name: Beidou
notes: An Electro burst sub-DPS: both sources put the Burst first and agree on 4pc Emblem of Severed Fate, an ATK% or ER Sands, an Electro DMG Goblet and a crit Circlet. The kit's 'Base DMG' line marked 'check' is ATK-based (the Max HP in the text is her shield). Game8 puts A Thousand Blazing Suns first; KQM lists Serpent Spine first and Beacon of the Reed Sea third, so the card takes Game8's first and KQM's second. Neither source gives stat goals. ER 140% is KQM's range for a team with Yae Miko (130-140% with one Perfect Counter and one tap Skill); her ER need runs from 110% to 250% by team. DMG 46.6% is the Goblet's main stat.
